text: On November 13, 2025, my wife, sister-in-law, and I all had dental treatments done at Dentopia.The clinic is well staffed, with skilled specialists for the various disciplines of dentistry, and boasts state-of-the-art equipment.  Dr.Atiphan Pimkhaokham, the head of the clinic and world renowned in dentistry, was very accommodating, ensuring we received excellent treatment.  Dr. Teerahida Sampathanakul, the dentist who conducted our checks and procedures, was both skilled and gentle, communicating in excellent English.  If you happen to be in Bangkok and need dental work, from cleaning to implants, I can recommend Dentopia.
